_readme: STAR WARS: SQUADRONS — refined profile v3 (menu-safe).
MENU FIX: the Xbox dashboard navigates on the LEFT STICK and the D-PAD.
If the flight stick rests even slightly off-centre it holds a menu
direction and nothing else can move. Left-stick deadzone is raised to 0.10
so a resting stick reads dead-centre, freeing the POV hat (d-pad) to drive
menus cleanly. The server also now requires a FULL hat throw before
emitting a d-pad direction, so a hat resting off-neutral can't hold either.
Your idle probe showed ABS_Z dithering 85<->86 and ABS_RX 78<->79 with
NOTHING touched. ABS_Z (throttle->rt) is a trigger the menu ignores, so its
jitter is harmless. ABS_RX is a rotary and stays UNMAPPED, so its dither
reaches nothing. Neither can affect menus.
THROTTLE: absolute on the RIGHT TRIGGER (rt). Bind in-game: Options >
Controls > Throttle axis -> Right Trigger (ABSOLUTE). Idle reads 0%,
POWER MANAGEMENT on the POV hat (d-pad) — engines/weapons/shields without
leaving the stick. Roll on twist (ABS_RZ). ry stays UNMAPPED so it can't jam.
MODES: mode1 FLIGHT, mode2 SYSTEMS/TARGETING, mode3 COMMS/MENU.
